extraction.Name: Philomena Beauvais (Leighton)
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded October 9, 1920 by C. L. Dice
extraction.Buyer: Leighton and her husband mortgaged the land for $500.00; then on February 2, 1921 they conveyed the land by deed to S. L. Funk for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739626 issued; Lots 1 and 2 and the south half of the northeast quarter of section 2, township 39, range 28; receipt for patent signed by allottee on April 8, 1920
